newsitem.title: UK: BG SAYS RESPONSE TO OFGAS "WITHIN A FEW DAYS".
newsitem.headline: BG SAYS RESPONSE TO OFGAS "WITHIN A FEW DAYS".

text.p: BG Plc will respond formally "within the next few days" to industry regulator Ofgas' statutory consultation on the draft licence conditions, a BG spokesman said on Thursday.

"Both Ofgas and BG have stated their intention to settle the Transco price formula on the basis of the MMC's (Monopolies and Mergers Commission) recommendations and to work together to translate these into detailed licence conditions," the spokesman told Reuters.
"That work is in hand and BG will soon be responding formally...it would be within the next few days," he said.
At 1034 GMT, shares in BG, the British gas transport and production company, were up 2-1/2p at 259p.
In late July, Ofgas departed from the MMC recommendations when publishing its detailed price control proposals for Transco, the pipeline and storage arm of BG.
Ofgas gave a 28-day consultation period for the industry to comment on the proposals.
The MMC published on June 18 a report on Transco's transport and storage pricing. MMC recommended a formula in which 50 percent of Transco's revenues varied according to the volume of gas it carried.
Ofgas said in July its proposals formed the basis of amended licence conditions "which gave effect to the MMC recommendations."
BG, at the time, disputed this and said it was "very disappointed" that Ofgas had departed from the recommendations.
